ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a pie distribution chart of the situation of various types of sea use in China in recent years, with proportions marked beside each category. It can be seen that the largest sector is "fishery 89.20%"; on the right side are marked "transportation 4.25%", "industry and mining 2.00%", "sea reclamation and land creation 1.91%", etc.; others such as "special 0.90%", "submarine engineering 0.62%", "tourism and entertainment 0.57%", "other 0.39%", and "sewage discharge and dumping 0.16%" have even smaller proportions. Then reason: comparing the proportions from large to small, fishery 89.20% is the largest; excluding fishery, transportation 4.25% is greater than industry and mining 2.00%, sea reclamation and land creation 1.91%, and other types, so the type with the second-largest proportion is transportation.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure below is a distribution chart of the situation of various types of sea use in China in recent years. Read the figure and answer the following question.

<image1>

Among the various types of sea use, what is the type with the second-largest proportion?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：该图是我国近年来各类用海状况的饼状分布图，图中每个类别旁标有百分比。读取所有可见类别的百分比后按从大到小排序：渔业89.20%最大，交通运输4.25%次之，其他类型如工矿2.00%、围海造地1.91%均小于4.25%。因此所占比例第二大的类型是交通运输。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一幅我国近年来各类用海状况的饼状分布图，各类别旁标有比例。可见最大扇区为“渔业 89.20%”，右侧标注有“交通运输 4.25%”“工矿 2.00%”“围海造地 1.91%”等，其他如“特殊 0.90%”“海底工程 0.62%”“旅游娱乐 0.57%”“其他 0.39%”“排污倾倒 0.16%”比例更小。再推理：按比例从大到小比较，渔业 89.20% 最大；除渔业外，交通运输 4.25% 大于工矿 2.00%和围海造地 1.91%等其他类型，所以所占比例第二大的类型是交通运输。
